environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance (t3.medium) in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway attached. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs with `threaded=True` via gunicorn with 4 workers and 8 threads per worker. No rate limiting, no WAF, no API Gateway in front. Public DNS resolves to the instance's Elastic IP.
